instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. The new `describe("per-range text styling", ...)` block (unit U17, briefs/U17.md) is still not applied: the last attempt failed in 'textWysiwyg > per-range text styling > updates whole-element strokeColor when selection is collapsed and supports undo/redo of range styling' -> after Keyboard undo, expected undone.textRanges toBeUndefined() but received [{start:0,end:5,highlightColor:'#ffec99'}]. Cause is the test's history model, not the code: while the editor is open, range styling is captured with CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY and folds into the edit session's single history entry (existing test 'history > does not open a history entry until the text is submitted'), so there is no separate undo step for a range applied mid-edit. Write the undo/redo case as: create an existing text element via API (e.g. text 'Hello world', no textRanges) and put it in the scene, open the editor on it, set editor.selectionStart=0/selectionEnd=5, apply the highlight, submit the editor (Escape or blur, as existing tests in this file do), assert textRanges set; then undo (Keyboard.undo / Ctrl+Z as existing history tests do) -> textRanges undefined and 'textRanges' in el === false; redo -> textRanges restored. Keep the other two new cases (they passed) and the collapsed-selection whole-element stroke case (set selectionStart = selectionEnd explicitly). Add the block at the end of the file without changing existing tests; no toMatchSnapshot.
